Honest users lock 150 units for 20 epochs, unlocking 5% per epoch; forgers lock 150 too, but their capital cannot roll, and the vertex stays honest.

Forgery freezes the clock: a miss resets the timer; 30% caught forfeit 60%, losing 27,000 of 150,000 across 1,000 clones, plus 10 more epochs.

Honest earn while waiting; forgers pay to wait. The tundra is cold for both, but only the honest thaw; the zephyr never reaches a forger locked 20 epochs.
